Chapter 11.3.2.1, Ethylene Density, 1974

This chapter is a computer subroutine and includes subordinate subroutines "rubin" and "taint" on one Fortran IV card deck. It will produce either a density (pounds/ft $ ^{3} $ ) or a compressibility factor for vapor phase

ethylene over the temperature range from 65 to $ 1 6 7^{\circ} \mathrm{F} $ and the pressure range from 200 to 2100 psia.

Price each, $100.00
